title: Hypergraph-Enhanced Evidence Selection for Long-Context Multimodal Document QA
abstract: arXiv:2610.35542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context multimodal document question answering (QA) has become an important yet challenging task for modern vision-language models (VLMs), as it requires reasoning over evidence dispersed across pages and modalities within limited input budgets. Current pipelines adopt retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to select multimodal evidence for downstream VLMs. However, existing systems mainly rely on static selection rules over fixed-granularity retrieval units such as pages or blocks, resulting in information loss during retrieval and suboptimal performance in downstream reasoning. translated_title: 超图增强的长上下文多模态文档问答证据选择
translated_abstract: 长上下文多模态文档问答已成为现代视觉语言模型（VLM）一项重要但具有挑战性的任务，因为它需要在有限的输入预算内，对分散在不同页面和不同模态中的证据进行推理。当前的流程采用检索增强生成（RAG）来为下游的视觉语言模型选择多模态证据。然而，现有系统主要依赖于基于固定粒度检索单元（如页面或文本块）的静态选择规则，导致检索过程中的信息丢失，并使下游推理性能不理想。为缓解这些问题，我们将核心任务形式化为对结构化文档证据的预算感知证据选择，并提出了HyperDoc——一个文档RAG框架，它在保留文档关系的同时构建紧凑且充分的证据。具体而言，HyperDoc构建了一个文档超图，以显式捕获结构、逻辑以及跨模态关系。
tldr: 提出HyperDoc框架，通过构建文档超图显式捕获结构、逻辑与跨模态关系，在有限输入预算下实现预算感知的多模态证据选择，从而提升长上下文多模态文档问答的性能。
en_tdlr: HyperDoc is a document RAG framework that constructs a document hypergraph to explicitly capture structural, logical, and cross-modal relations, enabling budget-aware evidence selection for improved long-context multimodal document QA.
